The setback stems from difficulties manufacturing a key circuit board at the heart of the system, SemiAnalysis said in a post on Monday.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

stored_reference_items.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that Nvidia's Kyber rack-scale architecture, designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028 because the NVL144 rack's multi-layer PCB midplane remains difficult to manufacture; SemiAnalysis also said the larger NVL576 system, which links eight racks via optical connections, is likely delayed or limited to small volumes.
source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.
The setback stems from difficulties manufacturing a key circuit board at the heart of the system, SemiAnalysis said in a post on Monday.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

stored_reference_items.summary: Nvidia rejected SemiAnalysis's report of a Kyber delay and stated that its product roadmap is intact.

stored_reference_items.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that NVIDIA's Kyber NVL144 rack architecture, the rack-scale system designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028 because the multi-layer PCB midplane remains difficult to manufacture, and that the larger NVL576 system (eight racks linked optically) is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes. SemiAnalysis concluded this leaves NVIDIA with no proven solution to expand scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra, which it said could give AMD and Google a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.
source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

That leaves Nvidia with "no proven solution to expand the scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra," SemiAnalysis said, predicting that could give rivals Advanced Micro Devices and Google , whose in-house chips are already winning business from top AI labs, a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.

stored_reference_items.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that NVIDIA's Kyber NVL144 rack architecture, the rack-scale system designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028 because the multi-layer PCB midplane remains difficult to manufacture, and that the larger NVL576 system (eight racks linked optically) is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes. source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

That leaves Nvidia with "no proven solution to expand the scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra," SemiAnalysis said, predicting that could give rivals Advanced Micro Devices and Google , whose in-house chips are already winning business from top AI labs, a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.

stored_reference_items.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that NVIDIA's Kyber NVL144 rack architecture, the rack-scale system designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028 because the multi-layer PCB midplane remains difficult to manufacture, and that the larger NVL576 system (eight racks linked optically) is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes. SemiAnalysis concluded this leaves NVIDIA with no proven solution to expand scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra, which it said could give AMD and Google a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.
source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

That leaves Nvidia with "no proven solution to expand the scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra," SemiAnalysis said, predicting that could give rivals Advanced Micro Devices and Google , whose in-house chips are already winning business from top AI labs, a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.

stored_reference_items.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that NVIDIA's Kyber NVL144 rack architecture, the rack-scale system designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028 because the multi-layer PCB midplane remains difficult to manufacture, and that the larger NVL576 system (eight racks linked optically) is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes. SemiAnalysis concluded this leaves NVIDIA with no proven solution to expand scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra, which it said could give AMD and Google a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.
source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

That leaves Nvidia with "no proven solution to expand the scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra," SemiAnalysis said, predicting that could give rivals Advanced Micro Devices and Google , whose in-house chips are already winning business from top AI labs, a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.

source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.

NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

kept_evidence.summary: Morgan Stanley Research, in a bill-of-materials analysis reported by MarketScale, estimates Nvidia's Vera Rubin VR200 NVL72 rack will cost hyperscale cloud providers about $7.8 million per unit, up from roughly $4 million for the current GB300 NVL72 generation, and that Nvidia will charge about $55,000 per Rubin GPU and $5,000 per Vera CPU in volume pricing. It puts memory content per rack at about $2 million, a 435% jump from the prior generation, driven by a threefold increase in LPDDR5X capacity to 54 terabytes per rack plus roughly $1 million or more in 3D NAND storage.
source_passages: Morgan Stanley Research estimates that Nvidia 's Vera Rubin VR200 NVL72 rack will cost hyperscale cloud providers around $7.8 million per unit, up from roughly $4 million for the current GB300 NVL72 generation. Morgan Stanley puts memory content per rack at about $2 million, a 435% jump from the prior generation, driven by a threefold increase in LPDDR5X capacity to 54 terabytes per rack plus roughly $1 million or more in 3D NAND storage that was virtually absent from earlier systems.
